title: Birthday Site

listing.shortDescription: A multi-page animated birthday experience — greeting, cake and celebration screens that turn a birthday message into a moment.
listing.fullDescription: A birthday should feel like an event, not an email. This site turns a birthday wish into a multi-page experience: a greeting screen, an animated cake page and a celebration finale. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript keep it effortless to host and share, while the animation does the emotional work.

cover.imageAlt: Birthday Site — Animated Birthday Celebration Site

closing.conclusion: The birthday site turned a celebration into a moment — an animated multi-page experience from greeting to cake that made the day feel special.
